tbesh_html:
1) to be or become low, sink, be humbled, be abased
1a) (Qal) to be or become low
1b) (Hiphil)
1b1) to lay or bring low, humiliate
1b2) to set in a lower place, show abasement
1b3) to make low, sit down

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to depress or sink (expectation figuratively, to humiliate, intransitive or transitive)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: abase, bring (cast, put) down, debase, humble (self), be (bring, lay, make, put) low(-er).
